title: Mixing: Spirits Of Ancient Egypt by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio 3, Wally Heider Recording, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

A mixing session for Wings’ fourth album Venus And Mars took place on 25 March 1975.

The album’s eighth song, ‘Spirits Of Ancient Egypt’, was mixed into stereo on this day.

Visiting the studio was Puerto Rican guitarist José Feliciano, who had attended the album launch party the previous night. After listening to the album mixes created thus far, the day ended with a jam session involving Feliciano and Wings.
